body:
## Summary

0.16.1 fixes the rows in #80, #81, #82 and #83. I then tried new values and close variants that were not in those issues. Most are replaced (102 of 128). The rest are kept, which suggests some of the rules follow the wording of the reported rows.

## Reproduction (0.16.1)

```js
import { sanitize } from '@link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer';
const text = (s) => sanitize(s, { profile: 'documents' }).text;
```

All values below are invented.

### Variants of forms that are now detected

| input | 0.16.1 |
|---|---|
| `контактный телефон 926 765 4321` | unchanged |
| `сот. 8 926 7654321` | unchanged |
| `petr.kuznetsov (собака) mail.example` | unchanged |
| `телега: petr_kuz` | unchanged |
| `Zoom: petr.kuz` | unchanged |
| `выдан ТП УФМС Перми 05.06.2015` | unchanged |
| `р/с 40817810500000000123` | unchanged |
| `г-н Кузнецов` | unchanged |
| `1985 года рождения` | unchanged |
| `г.р. 1985` | unchanged |
| `возраст 41` | unchanged |
| `Age 41` | unchanged |
| `Пол: Ж` | unchanged |
| `Пол: М` | unchanged |
| `пол: жен.` | unchanged |
| `пол муж.` | unchanged |
| `гражданин РФ` | unchanged |
| `есть двое детей` | unchanged |
| `проживаю в Перми` | unchanged |

For comparison, these close forms are replaced:

| input | 0.16.1 |
|---|---|
| `телефон: 9267654321` | `телефон: [REDACTED]` |
| `petr.kuznetsov собака mail.example` | `[REDACTED]` |
| `телеграм: petr_kuz` | `телеграм: [REDACTED]` |
| `1985 г.р.` | `[REDACTED] г.р.` |
| `возраст: 41 год` | `возраст: [REDACTED] год` |
| `Age: 41` | `Age: [REDACTED]` |
| `Пол: женский` | `Пол: [REDACTED]` |
| `живу в Перми` | `живу в [REDACTED]` |
| `г-жа Лебедева` | `г-жа [REDACTED]` |

### English labels

| input | 0.16.1 |
|---|---|
| `Employer: Vasilek` | unchanged |
| `Company: Vasilek` | unchanged |
| `Education: MSU` | unchanged |

The Russian labels `Работодатель:` and `Компания:` are detected.

### Initials with a surname that has no typical ending

| input | 0.16.1 |
|---|---|
| `Цой В. Р.` | unchanged |
| `Ким Д. С.` | unchanged |
| `Шевченко Т. Г.` | unchanged |

`docs/COVERAGE.md` already says the rules do not cover all surnames, and `Кузнецов П. Р.` is replaced. I list these only to ask: a capitalized word followed by two initials has the same shape whatever its ending. If the false-positive risk is too high, the existing limit is fine.

## Expected

The forms in the first and second tables are replaced, or `docs/COVERAGE.md` lists them as limits.

## Acceptance

- Each unchanged row is replaced, or documented as a limit.
- Durations stay unchanged (see #87), and so do `Срок 34 дня`, `Пол деревянный` and `Статус: открыт`.
title: documents profile 0.16.1: close variants of the newly detected forms are still kept (Пол: Ж, 1985 года рождения, р/с, проживаю в)
